name: cf-actions
description: Run GitHub Actions jobs on Cloudflare Containers in your own Cloudflare account

ADMIN_TOKEN.description: Password for the `/setup` and status pages (HTTP basic auth, any username). Generate one with `openssl rand -hex 32`.

ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: Encrypts the GitHub App private key at rest. Generate with `openssl rand -hex 32` and **do not change it after setup**.
